name: cloc
description: Source line counter with language detection and detailed statistics

cloc.description: Multi-language source code line counter with complexity metrics
cloc.usage:
cloc src/ # Count lines in source directory
cloc --by-file *.py # Per-file statistics for Python files
cloc --diff version1/ version2/ # Compare two code versions
cloc --exclude-dir=node_modules,dist . # Exclude specific directories
cloc --json --out=stats.json . # Output detailed JSON statistics
